_decision: The main option rows in the panel map exactly onto text-sm. Exact match to origin's bodyM.
_scale: Values come from the approved type mapping, not from measuring the component: Tailwind's own theme.css defines --text-base 1rem/1.5rem, --text-sm 0.875rem/1.25rem, --text-xs 0.75rem/1rem, --font-weight-medium 500.
_scope: Anchored to a RESTING leaf (`rules-engine`), deliberately not the selected one: a row on the active path renders at weight 500, so measuring there would prove D-7's claim and silently pass this one for the wrong reason.
